checkpoints.description: [1/1] a dependency-free static OpenAI-compatible chat client: streaming SSE, escaping-first Markdown, code copy, browser-local chats, settings, and a loopback static server; verified with 19 tests and a headless end-to-end stream against a mock server

impact_assessment.why: The chat UI is split out of ModelDuck so the model server and tuner stay focused, and the same client can target any OpenAI-compatible server
impact_assessment.benefits: A fast, inspectable chat front end with no build, no backend and no telemetry; ModelDuck becomes a server and coding tuner
impact_assessment.risks: contract: a new public app and UI contract; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: chats in localStorage and the API key in sessionStorage
impact_assessment.mitigation: Unit tests for the client, storage, Markdown and static server, plus a real headless stream smoke; escaping-first rendering and a loopback-only path guard

checkpoints.description: chat client, tests and static server in; headless Edge streamed a mock answer end to end; tests pass, gate 4/4; checklists: passed
[1/1] harden the client: parse CRLF SSE events, raise mid-stream error events, keep live conversation objects while sorting the sidebar, block new chats while streaming, and ignore IME Enter

impact_assessment.why: A review found edge cases that would silently drop answers or reorder the chat list incorrectly
impact_assessment.benefits: Interoperability with CRLF SSE servers, visible server errors, correct sidebar order while a reply streams
impact_assessment.risks: contract: client stream parsing and UI behavior; dependency: none; concurrency: one stream at a time; state: conversations stay in place
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first unit tests for CRLF and error events, plus the existing end-to-end stream smoke

checkpoints.description: CRLF parsing, mid-stream errors and live chat ordering in; 21 tests pass, gate 4/4; checklists: passed
